calls.title: Mikolaj and James Shannon
calls.summary: The discussion centered around the evaluation of GrowthBook as a unified, self-hosted feature flag backend to replace the existing systems of Unleash and Flipped, meeting the needs of both commercial and defense teams. Key decisions involve adopting the Open Feature SDK across most of the organization, while ensuring compliance with air-gapped on-prem solutions for defense. A total of about 50 developers require access to multiple GrowthBook instances, necessitating features like role-based access control and approval workflows for governance. The technical requirements include support for Python, Rust, and Typescript, along with GitOps capabilities. Pricing for GrowthBook's Enterprise tier is set at $30,000 annually plus $750 per user, aiming for deployment by September after a two-week evaluation trial.
calls.keywords: self-hosted, feature flags, Growth Book, Open Feature SDK, compliance, migration
